messages:
Anna: FYI we got a customer ticket where billing shows traffic attributed to the proxy project after edge exchanges the key. Minimal repro included.

Ben: Can you paste the repro? Is it every request or only some routes?

Anna: Curl below. Happens for flows that do key-exchange at the gateway.

```
# client -> edge
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer SK_CUST_123" https://edge.redwood/v1/chat

# edge -> service (current)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer PK_PROXY_999" https://internal.svc/handle
```

Anna: Proposal: edge should send a derived origin header (x-rw-origin-hash) or a short HMAC attestation so backend can attribute quota without seeing raw key id. Also emit metrics: auth.proxy_attrib.miss_count and auth.proxy_attrib.sample_trace.

Olga: Strong yes on derived id. Do not send raw key id. Also need retention policy and opt-in UX.

Kevin: Two implementation paths: (1) resolve origin before charging (accurate but adds latency), or (2) emit async attribution events from gateway to billing (eventual). Will prototype both.

Ben: Metric names OK. Dashboard idea: timeseries miss rate, top proxies table, links to sampled traces. Alert if miss_rate > 0.5% for 10m -> page eng-platform.

telemetry-bot: Metric lint: conventions passed (run 12a9).

Olga: Suggest console toggle per-org: "Preserve proxied origin for billing" (default off). Beta 1% orgs. Audit event when origin accepted.

Anna: I'll open RFC with header spec (HMAC'd token) + fallback/migration notes. @Ben add dashboard skeleton, @Olga draft privacy note, @Kevin measure latency tradeoffs.

Ben: Will do. Adding placeholder panels and alert.

Olga: I'll start privacy review and recommend sha256(key_id)[:12] as derived id if we can't manage HMAC verification.

Anna: Thanks all. I'll tag billing/sales in the RFC thread. :thumbsup:
